The ¹³C NMR shows six distinct carbons: a carbonyl (~168 ppm), two sp² carbons (~144 and 130 ppm) and three aliphatic carbons (~22–19 ppm). This pattern matches a linear unsaturated carboxylic acid, specifically 2‑hexenoic acid (HOOC‑CH=CH‑CH₂‑CH₂‑CH₃). The corresponding SMILES string is “O=C(O)C=CCCC”. This SMILES is valid and consistent with the observed data.</thought>
